messages:
Ellen: quick brief — we need a compact bench teaser for the launch email (3 visuals max) that feeds both sandbox signups and webinar leads. keep it snackable.

Marco: agreed. one-sentence hero: 'Predictable latency. Predictable bills.' subhead: 'See real token economics across typical app mixes.' under 6 words for hero.

Priya: visuals: 1) small scatter: cost per 1k tokens vs median latency (hosted vs dedicated) 2) GIF showing batching compressing many short prompts into fewer token units 3) p99 bar comparison with/without prefix caching. each visual gets a 10-12 word takeaway.

Gabe: callouts: show a realistic prompt mix (short chat, retrieval, long completion) and annotate quantized 4-bit profile so people know it's included. keep accuracy caveat: 'small accuracy tradeoffs for specialized quant profiles; see evals.'

Ellen: audience routing: corporate domains -> 'Book perf review' (short form), personal -> 'Run the 5-min sandbox'. collect company size bucket on the form. UTMs: bench_teaser_v1.

Marco: subject lines for A/B: A) 'Predictable latency. Predictable spend.' B) 'How much does inference really cost?' short test to 5k recipients first.

Priya: copy bullets (very short): 1) what we measured 2) typical savings (2-4x tokens) 3) tail impact (p99 within 50-100ms). one-sentence customer blurb possible but requires legal sign-off.

Gabe: eng action: produce CSV with hosted vs dedicated runs + quantized row, plus a small GIF export for batching. ETA Wed noon.

Ellen: include a quick curl snippet in the fold for devs: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-lite","prompt":"Hello","max_tokens":50}'
```

design-bot: Asset folder created: https://drive.redwood/bench-teaser-9001. Placeholder GIF and PNGs uploaded.

Priya: metrics: click->sandbox conversion, click->demo-book rate (corporate), webinar signups, CAC. Tag conversions with campaign=bench_teaser_v1.

Ellen: timeline: draft copy by Tue, design assets Wed, landing/forms Thurs, internal review Fri. send next Tue. keep claims conservative and cite the benchmark doc.

Marco: I'll ping #eng-ml for numbers and attach CSV. Gabe will coordinate GIF export.

Priya: routing details: if company email detected, show demo booking form with one extra question (company size). otherwise direct to sandbox flow with inline quickstart. map forms to HubSpot IDs when ready.

Ellen: thanks team — please comment on the Drive draft. :rocket:
